models.name: Elorian Glimpse
models.description: Glimpse is Elorian's visual reasoning model for understanding images and video and answering in text. It can analyze charts, count objects, follow events over time, and reason about spatial relationships and physical cause and effect. It supports tool calling and structured output across a shared 262,144-token context window, with up to 256,000 output tokens within the remaining context.

models.name: Beam 1.0 501B A23B
models.description: Reflection's Apache 2.0 open-weight text model with 501.3B total and 23.4B active parameters, built for coding, reasoning and tool use. It supports a shared 1,048,576-token context window, up to 131,072 output tokens, JSON mode and structured output. Reasoning is always enabled with low, medium, high, xhigh and max effort; NanoGPT defaults to max. Knowledge cutoff: June 30, 2026.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Fast by Heabsy
models.description: Heabsy's NVFP4 build of Qwen3.8-27B by Alibaba Cloud, with refusal removal based on huihui-ai's Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated. Quantized and calibrated by Heabsy, with unpublished weights under the Heabsy Model License. Supports text and image input, tools, and optional reasoning capped at 16,384 tokens within the output budget. This named build is separate from Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored.

models.name: Moondream 3 Preview
models.description: Moondream 3 Preview is the original 9B mixture-of-experts vision-language checkpoint with 2B active parameters, for visual question answering, captioning, OCR, and visual reasoning. It accepts text or one image with optional reasoning, a 32,000-token context, and up to 4,096 output tokens.

models.name: Moondream 3.1 9B A2B
models.description: Moondream 3.1 is the successor to Moondream 3 Preview: a distinct 9B mixture-of-experts vision-language checkpoint with 2B active parameters, for visual question answering, captioning, OCR, and visual reasoning. It accepts text or one image with optional reasoning, a 32,000-token context, and up to 4,096 output tokens.

models.name: Orion 26B A4B v1.1

models.name: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Super VL

models.name: LFM2.5 24B A2B
